 Dated this the 16th day of October, 2025
 Judgment

The above writ petition is filed with following prayers :
(i) Issue a writ of certiorari or any other appropriate writ, order or direction,
quashing the impugned order dated 03.07.2025 passed by the Adjudicating Officer,
Food Safety,
(ii) Declare that the Petitioner is not liable for the alleged contravention in the absence of any business connection or legal responsibility regarding the shop premises from which the product was seized;
(iii) Direct the Respondents to refrain from taking any coercive steps for recovery of the penalty amount from the Petitioner pursuant to the impugned order;
(iv) Grant such other reliefs, including costs of these proceedings, as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the interests of justice."

sentences.text: Admittedly, Ext.P7 is an appealable order.
If that is the case, this writ petition need not be retained here.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, further proceedings based on Ext.P7 can be kept in abeyance for a short period, so that the petitioner can challenge the same before the appellate authority.

Therefore, this writ petition is disposed of with the following directions :
1) Further proceedings based on Ext.P7 shall be kept in abeyance for a period of one month.
2) In the meanwhile, the petitioner can avail statutory remedy in accordance with law.
